changes.title: Modernise the shared page header, list pages and the Settings front
changes.detail:
About a hundred pages shared one tired header, so they all get the new one at once: a round back button, a heavy title that wraps instead of giving up with an ellipsis, pill tabs with an indicator that slides, and a page-entry rise that respects the motion preference and reduced motion. List pages lose the stack of chrome: statistics are one strip of numerals, the tools fit one row with the overflow behind More, rows are tall rounded blocks, the selection row replaces the tool row in place, and the "Showing N of N" sentence only speaks when a filter is actually hiding something. On a phone the list had two scrollers fighting over one finger; now there is one. The Settings front leads with its search, one amber block when something needs attention, four numeral tiles and compact rows for everything else.

Seen in a local build at 390 and 1440 px. Checks: types at the two known gallery errors, tests at the three known build-script failures.
changes.detail_yue:
翻新共用頁首、清單頁同設定首頁

成百頁共用同一個老頁首，今次一次過換晒：圓形返回掣、識得換行 唔再「…」嘅粗標題、有滑動指示嘅藥丸分頁、同埋尊重動態偏好嘅入場 動畫。清單頁唔再疊到成座山：統計變成一行數字，工具一行排晒， 放唔落嘅收入「更多」，每行變高身圓角，選取列原地取代工具列， 「顯示 N 之 N」得返真係有嘢被過濾先出聲。手機上面兩個捲軸爭一隻 手指嘅問題都解決咗，得返一個。設定首頁以搜尋做主角，有嘢要處理先 出琥珀色方塊，四塊大數字磚，其餘用精簡行。

喺本機建置 390 同 1440 闊度睇過。型別檢查維持兩個已知錯誤， 測試維持三個已知失敗。

changes.title: Add design canvas 35: boards for the new features
changes.detail:
Thirteen boards, drawn before a line of product code, so nobody has to guess what "a visual editor for every action" means at two in the morning. The automation editor now reads as one sentence with numbered blocks, every action gets controls made for the thing it controls instead of a code box that stares back, and helpers can be made, changed and removed without leaving the editor. Also on the canvas: modern dialogs and phone bottom sheets, one shared empty state, tiles that filter, tidied developer tools, update history with going back, backup self-check, USB stick maker, offline pack, the away digest, device health, dry run, the room wizard and the cloud host.

References only. No product page changed in this commit.
changes.detail_yue:
新增設計畫布 35：新功能嘅畫板

十三塊畫板，寫產品程式之前畫好，費事半夜兩點先嚟估「每個動作都有 視覺編輯器」即係乜。自動化編輯器而家讀落似一句說話再加編號方塊， 每個動作都有度身訂造嘅控制，唔再係一格冷冰冰嘅程式碼框；輔助項目 喺編輯器入面就可以新增、修改同移除。其餘仲有新式對話框同手機底部 面板、統一嘅空白狀態、識過濾嘅磚、整理好嘅開發者工具、更新紀錄同 還原、備份自我檢查、USB 手指製作、離線更新包、離家摘要、裝置健康、 試行、房間精靈同雲端主機。

純參考，今次冇改任何產品頁面。

changes.title: Backups list on a phone: keep the hosting buttons out of the text line
changes.detail:
On a narrow table every column without a slot of its own is joined into the second line under the name. The two hosting icon buttons qualified, so each row read "8.87 GB, 1 hour ago, [server icon]" and then gave up with an ellipsis. They are hidden on narrow layouts now; the same two actions were already in the row menu. The disabled "Back up now" button also says why it is disabled.

Not yet looked at in a browser. The scrolling report is still open.
changes.detail_yue:
手機睇備份清單：唔好再將託管掣塞入文字行

窄版表格會將冇自己位嘅欄全部串埋落名下面第二行，兩粒託管圖示掣 啱啱好中招，搞到每行讀到一半就「…」。而家窄版收埋佢哋，功能本身 喺行尾選單一早有。「立即備份」停用嗰陣都會講原因。

未喺瀏覽器睇過，捲動問題仲未解決。

changes.title: Add design canvas 34: the full interface polish direction
changes.detail:
Six boards that tell every page to pick one loud thing and let the rest sit down. The stock look had eighteen equal rows all shouting at the same volume, which is the visual equivalent of a meeting with no agenda. Now the front door, the Settings front and a list page each have a hero, big numerals for counts, tiles that double as filters, and two phone boards that prove nothing gets thrown overboard on a small screen. The motion board has six buttons, one per moment that has actually earned a little theatre; everything else stays still on purpose.

These are references only. No product page changed in this commit.
changes.detail_yue:
新增設計畫布 34：成個介面嘅翻新方向

六塊畫板，叫每一頁揀一樣嘢大聲，其餘收聲。以前十八行一齊嗌， 好似開會冇議程咁。而家首頁、設定首頁同清單頁都有主角、大數字、 識得過濾嘅磚，仲有兩塊手機畫板證明細螢幕都冇嘢被掉走。動態畫板 有六粒掣，每粒對應一個真係值得做戲嘅時刻，其他時候乖乖唔郁。

純參考，今次冇改任何產品頁面。
